title: Ex vivo differentiation of resting CD4+ T cells coupled with the QVOA
author: Elizabeth R Wonderlich
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5h2g38e

steps.title: Identify tubes and thaw PBMC
steps.instruction: Label 50 mL conical tubes with the experiment ID and add 10 mL cold FBS to each. Thaw up to four 1 mL vials of DMSO‑containing freeze‑media per tube (maximum 4 mL total) in a 37 °C water bath, checking every 10 seconds after the first minute until a pea‑size frozen sphere remains. Rinse each cryovial with 1 mL RPMI‑1640 using a P1000 pipette and combine the rinse with the thawed contents.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge thawed PBMC
steps.instruction: Transfer the thawed cell suspension to the 50 mL conical tube containing cold FBS, bring the total volume to 50 mL with RPMI‑1640, and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4 °C. Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend PBMC and overnight culture
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL cold FBS, then bring the tube to 50 mL with RPMI‑1640. Centrifuge again for 10 minutes at 4 °C and discard the supernatant. Resuspend the PBMC at 3 × 10⁶ cells/mL in R10 media (RPMI‑1640 with GlutaMAX, 1 % NEAA, 1 % PenStrep, 1 % 1 M HEPES, 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS) and place in tissue‑culture‑treated flasks. Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight (15–19 h).

steps.title: Resting CD4+ enrichment
steps.instruction: Perform resting CD4⁺ T‑cell enrichment using the StemCell kit with the following steps:

substeps.instruction: Evenly distribute the overnight PBMC suspension into 50 mL conical tubes and centrifuge 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells at 5 × 10⁷ cells/mL in R10.
Add 50 µL CD4 isolation antibody cocktail and 50 µL CD25 antibody cocktail per 1 mL cell suspension; mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Vortex magnetic particles for >30 seconds, then add 75 µL magnetic particles per 1 mL cell suspension; mix by pipetting.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add R10 to the maximum volume recommended by the StemCell protocol.
Place the tube in the magnetic separator for 10 minutes at room temperature; resting CD4⁺ cells remain in the supernatant.
Without removing the tube from the magnet, pipette the supernatant (resting‑enriched CD4⁺ cells) into a new conical tube and retain an aliquot for counting.

steps.title: Count and prepare rCD4+ cells
steps.instruction: Count resting‑enriched CD4⁺ (rCD4⁺) cells using trypan blue. Centrifuge the counted rCD4⁺ cells for 10 minutes at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in differentiation media (R10 plus 25 ng/mL each of recombinant human IL‑6, IL‑7, IL‑10, IL‑15, and TNF‑α).

steps.title: Plate rCD4+ cells in limiting dilution
steps.instruction: Distribute rCD4⁺ cells into wells as follows (total 22 wells on Day ‑7):

substeps.instruction: A wells (12 wells, 24‑well plate): add 500 µL (5 × 10⁵ cells) per well, then add 500 µL differentiation media to bring each well to 1 mL.
B wells (6 wells, 96‑well round‑bottom plate): add 200 µL (2 × 10⁵ cells) per well; final volume is 200 µL (no topping up).
C wells (2 wells, 96‑well round‑bottom plate): add 40 µL (4 × 10⁴ cells) per well, then add 160 µL differentiation media to reach 200 µL total.
D wells (2 wells, 96‑well round‑bottom plate): add 8 µL (8 × 10³ cells) per well, then add 192 µL differentiation media to reach 200 µL total.
Add sterile liquid (PBS or water) to any empty wells in the 24‑ and 96‑well plates to minimize evaporation.

steps.title: Differentiate rCD4+ cells first four days
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated rCD4⁺ cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 4 days. If the media turns yellow, prepare fresh differentiation media and replace half of the volume in each well:

substeps.instruction: A wells: gently remove 500 µL media and add 500 µL fresh differentiation media.
B, C, and D wells: gently remove 100 µL media and add 100 µL fresh differentiation media.

steps.title: Continue differentiation additional three days
steps.instruction: Continue incubating the rCD4⁺ cultures at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for another 3 days, performing the same half‑volume media replacements as described for the first 4‑day period.

steps.title: Prepare γ‑irradiated allogeneic PBMC
steps.instruction: Generate allogeneic stimulator cells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Irradiate HIV‑naïve buffy coats from two donors at 5000 R using a Cs‑6 source; immediately place the irradiated buffy coats on ice.
Process each buffy coat into PBMC by standard density‑gradient centrifugation (e.g., Ficoll, Histopaque, LSM).
After the final wash, centrifuge the γ‑irradiated PBMC for 10 minutes at 4 °C and discard supernatant.
Resuspend the irradiated PBMC at 2.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in stimulation media (R10 containing 0.5 µg/mL REMEL PHA and 100 IU/mL recombinant human IL‑2). Keep on ice until use.

steps.title: Transfer differentiated cells and add allogeneic PBMC
steps.instruction: Move differentiated rCD4⁺ cultures to larger stimulation plates and add irradiated PBMC:

substeps.instruction: A wells: without splitting or cross‑contamination, resuspend each 24‑well (1 mL) culture and transfer the entire volume to a fresh 6‑well plate. Add 2 mL (5 × 10⁶ cells) irradiated PBMC to each well, then top up to 8 mL with 5 mL stimulation media.

B, C, D wells: without splitting or cross‑contamination, resuspend each 96‑well (0.2 mL) culture and transfer the entire volume to a fresh 24‑well plate. Add 1 mL (2.5 × 10⁶ cells) irradiated PBMC to each well, then top up to 2 mL with 0.8 mL stimulation media.
G wells (negative controls): add 1 mL (2.5 × 10⁶ cells) irradiated PBMC to each G well, then top up to 2 mL with 1 mL feeding media (R10 + 100 IU/mL IL‑2).

steps.title: Replace PHA with feeding media
steps.instruction: Remove PHA from all wells by discarding the existing media and adding feeding media (R10 containing 100 IU/mL IL‑2). Save any removed supernatant for later analysis.

steps.title: Overnight incubation post‑stimulation
steps.instruction: Incubate the 6‑well (A) and 24‑well (B/C/D/G) plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for >17 hours.

steps.title: Feed media replacement and incubation
steps.instruction: Perform the first feeding media change without disturbing the cell layer:

substeps.instruction: A wells (6‑well plates): remove 6 mL media and add 6 mL feeding media.
B, C, D, G wells (24‑well plates): remove 1.5 mL media and add 1.5 mL feeding media.
Add sterile liquid (PBS or water) to any empty wells to minimize evaporation.
Incubate plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 4 days. If media turns yellow, replace half of the feeding media volume (A wells: 4 mL; B/C/D/G wells: 1 mL).

steps.title: Harvest supernatants and store
steps.instruction: Collect culture supernatants from all wells, freeze aliquots at –80 °C until endpoint analysis. (Optional: harvest cell pellets, wash in PBS, and store at –80 °C for future assays.)

steps.title: Perform p24 ELISA assay
steps.instruction: Use PerkinElmer Alliance p24 antigen ELISA kits according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Test each supernatant in duplicate wells; consider a well positive if the measured p24 concentration exceeds 3.25 pg/mL.

steps.title: Calculate IUPM values
steps.instruction: Determine infectious units per million rCD4⁺ T cells (IUPM) using the maximum‑likelihood method implemented in IUPMStats v1.0 (available at http://silicianolab.johnshopkins.edu/).
